domain.text: tooling: worker management CLI and model-log grading

impressions.text: The delivery added gateway-backed worker management, model-switch tracking, status diagnostics, and issue-only grading; the owner also verified selected commands against live services.
The worker’s reported strengths include extensive offline coverage, explicit permission and provider-error handling, and avoiding automatic model switching.
Review and integration caught a board-field date parsing bug in #24 and conflicts requiring preservation of watch, task-flow, CI/verify, and worker-management operations.
The worker reported one earlier full-suite run hit an existing child-process timeout under local load; a focused rerun and a later full run passed.
The owner requested renewed verification and a single handover approval after integration; the thread does not state a stop or escalation.

roundCauses.text: Round 2 addressed the dev-integration amendment, including conflict resolution and the board-fixture correction.
Round 3 addressed task-flow integration, including conflict resolution and template/header corrections.
